name: Deliver a feature end-to-end
summary: The top-altitude journey of shipping a feature with Leafcutter: you say what you want and the acceptance criteria get authored (plan), the wired ticket is driven through its phase agents until it is green and committed (build), and the PR is merged and the epic/ticket closed (finalize). Each of the three stages drills down into its own pipeline flow — plan into define-a-feature, build into how-a-ticket-is-built, finalize into the finalize-feature pipeline — so this journey is the C4 L0 map over the whole delivery system.

steps.label: Plan
steps.human: Say what you want; the ACs get authored.

steps.label: Build
steps.human: The wired ticket is driven through its phase agents.

steps.label: Finalize
steps.human: The PR is merged and the epic/ticket is closed.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a person with a feature idea
acceptance_scenarios.when: they describe it in plain language
acceptance_scenarios.then: the acceptance criteria are authored via the define-a-feature pipeline this step drills into

acceptance_scenarios.given: a wired ticket produced from approved ACs
acceptance_scenarios.then: the ticket is driven through the phase chain this step drills into until it is green and committed

acceptance_scenarios.given: a committed feature branch with an open PR
acceptance_scenarios.then: the PR is merged and the epic/ticket is closed via the finalize-feature pipeline this step drills into

provenance.note: L0 journey introducing the SUB-FLOW / drill-down hierarchy: plan -> define-a-feature, build -> how-acs-are-built, finalize -> finalize-feature.
